name: scholar-workflow
description: Plan-first scholarly resource management with a local research Hub: manage papers through Zotero, maintain readable Obsidian and Notion projections, build literature trees, analyze papers, coordinate agents, and initialize Git-managed project skeletons.

interface.shortDescription: Local research Hub, resources, and workflows
interface.longDescription: Browse a local research Hub; discover, verify, import, organize, and analyze scholarly resources; initialize Git-managed research projects; and coordinate bounded work across agent runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Survey a research topic and build a literature map.
Find a paper, check my Zotero library, and import it safely.
Analyze a saved paper and update my research notes.
Initialize a new project with the standard Git-managed skeleton.
